messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up 90-day renewal flag for HelioStream. Customer reports slower ticket summarization and a 22% jump in monthly token spend. AE asked for quick mitigation plan. Thoughts?
Tom (SE): Can we get a breakdown by sample type? long-form summaries vs short replies will behave differently under quantization.
Priya (RE): I ran a quick parse of last 72h. 68% of calls are <= 600 tokens. 12% are >1500 and skew cost. I think a compact model + prefix caching could cut unit cost, but need to validate hallucination delta.
Noah (AE): Customer is sensitive to accuracy. If we propose int8, we need an exec summary they can share with their legal/ops. Also they want a timeline before renewal touch next Tuesday.
Lina (CS): Ok proposed mitigations (quick wins): 1) Canary compact-int8 for <=1024 requests with prefix_kv on. 2) Route >1024 to redwood-standard-1-fp16. 3) Reserve small dedicated pool for p99 spikes during business hours. 4) Provide customer-facing one-pager.
Tom (SE): I'll spin a staging split route and run perf delta. plan: 85% compact-int8, 10% standard-fp16, 5% dedicated. Will also enable batching config tweaks.
Priya (RE): I'll run offline eval on their top 10k prompts (we have consent) for bleu/embedding drift + hallucination heuristics. Will include a few high-risk prompts HelioStream flagged.
InfraBot: [quota-check] HelioStream account usable dedicated GPUs=2 available.
Lina (CS): Thanks. Target: get numbers by EOD tomorrow. Noah will you confirm stakeholder call availability?
Noah (AE): I can get them a short sync on Monday 11am PT. Will ask for 3 example cases where they "noticed" regressions.
Tom (SE): Snippet I'm deploying to staging (preview):
```
route {
  match: path: "/api/v1/summarize"
  condition: "seq_len <= 1024"
  split: "85/15"
  models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
  fallback: "dedicated-small"
}
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
batching: { max_batch_ms: 50, max_tokens: 1500 }
```
Priya (RE): Add AB tests for prefix_kv on vs off and int8 vs fp16. I'll compute cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.
Lina (CS): Also capture rollback triggers: >2% accuracy regression on HelioStream eval set OR any customer-critical case failing. List that in one-pager.
Tom (SE): Deploying staging route now. Will post dashboards & a brief CSV of p50/p95/p99 and token_cpm delta.
InfraBot: [deploy] staging-split-route applied by tom at 2025-10-03T09:14Z (id: dpl_4822233388)
Priya (RE): Uploaded eval artifacts to /shared/heliostream-evals. Early numbers: int8 median latency -12%, p99 -18%, estimated token cost -24%, BLEU delta negligible on 92% of samples, 3 flagged prompts with reduced faithfulness (investigating).
Noah (AE): Great. Lina, can we craft the one-pager with those high-level numbers + clear next steps for full rollout & rollback? I'll coordinate customer review.
Lina (CS): I'll draft and share a customer-friendly PDF by EOD. Add a note requesting their 3 failure examples and to sign off on a 2-week pilot.
Tom (SE): One more note: for extreme long tails (>3k tokens) we should keep them on dedicated with fp16. That avoids any chance of quality degradation.
Priya (RE): Agree. I'll annotate the eval with per-length bucket metrics so the customer sees tradeoffs by seq_len.
Lina (CS): Action items: Tom94 staging perf & dashboard (ETA 2h), Priya94 eval triage + flagged cases (ETA 3h), Noah94 customer sync Monday (confirm), Lina94 one-pager + pilot request (ETA EOD).
Noah (AE): I'll also surface potential renewal concession options if pilot shows expected savings.
Lina (CS): Thanks team. Keep thread light & post any blockers. :thumbsup:
